items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the frost-fractured valve. Case 16 supports €52 gross for one valve.
Section 7.1.9 covers connection elements that must be renewed with the fractured fitting. Case 16 supports €30 gross for one standard hose.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover necessary labour for the internal repair. Three hours at €96 gross total €288, consistent with the lower bound in Case 16.

Section 7.1.7(e) covers consumables actually used in the repair, but section 3.6(c) excludes the contractor's own tools and small equipment. Allow €9 gross if the line is supported as repair consumables, consistent with Case 16.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 allow one attendance by the plumber for covered work. Case 16 supports €65 gross for the single trip.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging used to locate the internal escape. Allow €50 gross for equipment use, below the €2,500 gross event cap; no deductible amount is stated.

Sections 2.6.4 and 3.5 exclude outdoor frost damage because the optional peril is not shown as agreed. No escaped water reached the facade, so section 2.4.3 does not apply and the payable amount is €0.
Section 3.5(b) excludes removal of failed exterior plaster where the underlying outdoor frost damage is uninsured. Payable: €0.
Sections 3.5(b) and 7.1.7 exclude substrate reinstatement on the uninsured facade. Payable: €0.
Sections 3.5(d) and 7.1.10 exclude the upgrade. Because the underlying facade repair is uninsured, there is no allowance even for the equivalent plain render: €0.
Section 3.5(b) excludes reforming the substrate beneath render damaged by uninsured outdoor frost. Payable: €0.
Section 3.5(b) excludes the finish coats on the uninsured facade regardless of the number applied. Payable: €0.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting separate undamaged elevations for uniform appearance, even if the original facade damage were covered. Payable: €0.
Section 3.5(b) expressly excludes priming in consequence of uninsured outdoor frost damage. Payable: €0.
Sections 3.5(c) and 7.1.11 exclude labour attributable to uninsured facade work. None of the five hours is payable.
Under sections 7.1.12–7.1.13 and 9.6, the flat rate cannot be allocated to any covered work. If it is an administrative surcharge instead, section 3.6(b) also excludes it; payable €0.
